terms.gloss: humbly begging, entreating; as a noun, a suppliant
evidence: Cic. Phil. 2.86: supplex tē ad pedēs abjiciēbās (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Cat. 4.18: vōbīs supplex manūs tendit patria commūnis (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: vōbīs supplex manūs tendit patria commūnis
phrases.english: the country we share stretches out her hands to you in entreaty
